description: This file contains Redux action creators and related functions for handling post-related actions in a Mattermost web application, including creating, flagging, reacting, editing, and managing post visibility and state.

methods.name: handleNewPost
methods.description: Handles processing of a new post, including fetching channel membership info and loading direct or group messages if needed.

methods.name: flagPost
methods.description: Flags a post and updates search results if the RHS is in flag mode.

methods.name: unflagPost
methods.description: Removes a flag from a post and updates search results if the RHS is in flag mode.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Creates a new post, adds recent emojis, and optionally clears drafts.

methods.name: createSchedulePostFromDraft
methods.description: Creates a scheduled post from a draft.

methods.name: storeDraft
methods.description: Stores a draft message for a channel.

methods.name: storeCommentDraft
methods.description: Stores a draft reply to a specific post.

methods.name: submitReaction
methods.description: Submits a reaction (add or remove) to a post, checking if reaction already exists.

methods.name: toggleReaction
methods.description: Toggles a reaction on a post.

methods.name: addReaction
methods.description: Adds a reaction to a post, respecting reaction limit and showing modal if limit exceeded.

methods.name: searchForTerm
methods.description: Updates search terms and shows search results in RHS.

methods.name: addPostToSearchResults
methods.description: Adds a post to search results if not already present, sorting posts accordingly.

methods.name: removePostFromSearchResults
methods.description: Removes a post from search results.

methods.name: pinPost
methods.description: Pins a post and adds it to search results if RHS is in pin mode.

methods.name: unpinPost
methods.description: Unpins a post and removes it from search results if RHS is in pin mode.

methods.name: setEditingPost
methods.description: Sets a post into editing mode, loading draft if available, and checking permissions.

methods.name: unsetEditingPost
methods.description: Exits post editing mode and removes draft from storage.

methods.name: markPostAsUnread
methods.description: Marks a post as unread, handling thread follow if collapsed threads are enabled.

methods.name: markMostRecentPostInChannelAsUnread
methods.description: Marks the most recent post in a channel as unread.

methods.name: deleteAndRemovePost
methods.description: Deletes a post and removes it from state, clearing selection if needed.

methods.name: toggleEmbedVisibility
methods.description: Toggles embed visibility for a post.

methods.name: resetEmbedVisibility
methods.description: Resets embed visibility for all posts.

methods.name: toggleInlineImageVisibility
methods.description: Toggles inline image visibility for a post.

methods.name: resetInlineImageVisibility
methods.description: Resets inline image visibility for all posts.

methods.name: emitShortcutReactToLastPostFrom
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a shortcut reaction was triggered from a specific location.
